task.title: Define the Operator Console backlog and wave plan
task.summary_zh: 整理 Operator Console 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: dashboard, alerts, health, runtime state, paper-live drift, deployment review, incident response, and post-incident coverage are all listed
each module records existing Pantheon support, missing canonical screen specs, Lovable readiness, and backend dependencies
the recommended execution wave is explicit for every operator module
task.next: WB-001 finalized: Operator Console backlog is committed with OC-01 through OC-10 inventory, explicit Wave 1/Wave 2 ordering, and clear aggregation-contract gating before Lovable handoff.
review_notes_zh: Operator Console OC-01 到 OC-10 全部列出；每個模組均記錄現況支撐、缺規格、Lovable readiness 與 backend dependencies；Wave 1/Wave 2 區分及 Wave 2 內部 dependency chain 皆明確。
Wave 2 模組的 aggregation contract 缺口（OC-01 至 OC-05）已清楚標注，且明確聲明不得在 BFF surface 就緒前移交 Lovable，符合 honesty-of-handoff 原則。
WB-008 Evolution Workbench 範圍已出現在同一份文件下方，需在 WB-008 review 中另行確認；本次 review 僅涵蓋 WB-001 Operator Console scope。
